decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered Figure 03Rev1, Figure 04, Planning Statement, Received 5 January 2011 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - The external materials used in the construction of the gate shall be coloured black, unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The flood gate shall remain open to allow public access to and from the Tow Path except when required by the Environment Agency at times of high tides or high flows, when it will be required to be latched in the closed position.
Condition : 5 - No lock or other mechanism to prevent access by the general public through the gate except for the latching mechanism hereby approved shall be attached to the gate.
description: Replacement of existing exterior steps with lower steps and a hinged flood gate, removal of flood board brackets to front elevation of the premises and installation of laminate glass screens.
